_comment: Interior room template (PROCGEN_INTERIOR.md §8). Backs both the 'C++: Generate Room' spell and the generate_interior adapter action. base = vanilla EditorID (LookupByEditorID) or '0x..~Mod.esp' (FormUtil::Parse). pos/grid in LOCAL frame relative to the room origin (anchorDistance units in front of the caster). rot_deg in DEGREES (adapter converts to radians). motion: fixed|keyframed|dynamic. THESE EDITORIDS NEED IN-GAME VALIDATION — see TODO note at the bottom.

shell._comment: floor grid 3x2 (grid coords * grid_step). Marsh/farmhouse floor STAT. PLACEHOLDER EditorID — validate.
walls along the floor edges (STAT). PLACEHOLDER EditorID — validate. rot_deg.z faces the wall inward.

furniture_slots._comment: Bed against the back wall. CommonBed01 is a known vanilla furniture EditorID family.
Table + two chairs in the centre. CommonTableSquare01 / WoodChair01 — validate exact ids.

lights._comment: Candle/candlelight to brighten the room (TESObjectLIGH with model). DefaultCandleLight01NS is a known vanilla light. Validate.

clutter._comment: Tankards scattered on the table AABB (count + seed → deterministic scatter, JSON path only). Tankard01 is a vanilla MISC.

navmesh_note: Generated area has NO runtime navmesh; NPCs cannot path here (NAVMESH_FREE_PATHFINDING.md). Player can walk/sit/sleep on placed furniture (markers ride the NIF).

Unknown ids log a warning and are skipped (no crash). Replace shell wall/floor with a real modular interior kit (e.g. RiverwoodHouse* or a FarmHouse* STAT family) once measured; grid_step must match that kit's piece pitch.
